description: Work out what a temp or agency worker really costs an employer in Ireland per week and per hour: pay, holiday pay accrual, employer PRSI (correct band and rate for the date), MyFutureFund auto-enrolment, optional construction CWPS, and the margin if a client charge rate is given.

auto_enrolment.description: Optional: include the 1.5% employer auto-enrolment contribution. Default true

charge_rate.description: Optional: hourly rate charged to the client in EUR, to show the margin

construction_cwps.description: Optional: add the CWPS weekly employer contribution for construction workers. Default false

date.description: Optional: YYYY-MM-DD the week falls in, to use that date's PRSI rates. Default today

holiday_accrual_pct.description: Optional: holiday pay accrual %. Default 12.35 (8% annual leave + about 4.35% for 10 public holidays)

hours_per_week.description: Hours worked in the week (up to 80)

name: temp_worker_cost_ireland
title: Temp worker cost (Ireland)
